core_memory.mental_stimulation: engages in activities that challenge the mind, such as puzzles, reading, learning new skills, and taking online classes, to maintain cognitive health and prevent decline
core_memory.pain_management: manages chronic pain using techniques such as warm baths with Epsom salts, heating pads, and exploring alternative therapies like tai chi or gentle stretching
